scripts.install:backend: npm install express cors multer dotenv jsonwebtoken mkcert selfsigned nodemailer pinia vue vue-router vue-i18n axios @google-cloud/documentai bcryptjs --prefix backend && npm install --save-dev nodemon --prefix backend
scripts.install:frontend: npm install axios vue-i18n vue@next vue-router@4 pinia@latest --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run worker --prefix backend"
